description:
Hey! We're NORLA 🚀 A team passionate about technology, science, and innovation. We're joining NASA Space Apps 2026 to explore new ideas, learn together, and build something meaningful.

We're interested in AI, software development, data analysis, design, and space science. We're looking for creative, motivated people who enjoy teamwork and aren't afraid of new challenges.

No need to be an expert. Just bring your curiosity and ideas. Let's create something amazing! 🌌
